package.name: Gonerino
package.shortDescription: Block YouTube channels, videos, and keywords from your feeds

descriptionlist.description: A YouTube tweak that allows you to block specific channels and automatically remove their videos from your feed.
• Block channels or individual videos from YouTube menus
• Filter feeds by channel, video, or keyword
• Remove blocked recommendations from Home, Search, related feeds, and Shorts
• Hide "People also watched" and "You might also like" sections
